items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Eat any Pre-war Food like BlamCo Mac and Cheese or Pork n' Beans, or collect from Weenie Wagon, Popcorn Machine, or Cookie Jar.

items.title: Build Anything in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your shelter and place any item in the build menu.

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Teddy Bears can be found on a ledge northeast of Knife Edge; use a grenade to knock them down.

items.title: Kill a Creature while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team (can be solo), then kill creatures like Scorched at Morgantown Airport.

items.title: Kill a Human Enemy with a Power Tool Weapon
items.detail: Use motorized melee weapons like Chainsaws on human enemies; Point Pleasant has many Cultists.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Silver
items.detail: Buy silver jewelry and dinnerware from Helena at Aurum in Whitespring Mall, then scrap at any workbench.

items.title: Use Photomode in your own C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Open Photomode at your C.A.M.P. and take a photo with available settings.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Collect Caps from containers or sell looted items to vendors at train stations.

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Five to eight Garden Gnomes are in the walled garden and shed behind The General's Steakhouse in the Mire.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and enter the Daily Operation from World Activity on the map.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Travel to Highway Town via Bounty Board, interact with the Bounty pile in The Last Resort, and eliminate the assigned Outlaw.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for reliable robot spawns; use energy weapons or V.A.T.S.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild locations or farms like Silva Homestead, or plant crops at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume item (hat or mask counts) and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms near cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds.

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Fast travel to Wavy Willard's Water Park in Toxic Valley for reliable Scorched spawns; use V.A.T.S. targeting the head.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench at your C.A.M.P. or Whitespring Resort, then scrap it.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week by completing all six regular dailies each day.

events.name: Night at the Morgue
events.description: Spooky Scorched mini season event with daily and weekly challenges involving candy bowls, trick-or-treating, pumpkins, and seasonal enemies in costumes.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Halloween-themed Scorched enemies that spawn as legendary creatures wearing costumes.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Experience points are doubled during this weekend period.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run
events.description: Improved rates for catching seasonal fish this weekend.
